DENSE, NOT MoE. No num_experts key. Therefore the entire Q80 expert machinery - moe_table_build, expert residency, device top-k, expert address tables, first-touch upload - is NOT NEEDED. Every wall that dominated Q80 this session is absent here.

HYBRID linear/full attention, 48 linear + 16 full on a 4-interval schedule. This is the SAME STRUCTURAL FAMILY as Q80's DeltaNet(36)+GQA(12) hybrid. qwen80_hybrid_token_graph.rs and the DeltaNet/GQA schedule machinery are strong PARAMETRIC_REUSE candidates - far better starting point than qwen_dense.rs.
Linear attention is gated-deltanet shaped: conv_kernel_dim 4, key/value head dim 128, 16 key heads / 48 value heads. Compare directly against Q80 DeltaNet before writing anything new.
Full attention is GQA 24:4 (ratio 6) with head_dim 256 - Q80 GQA machinery is a parametric fit.

MULTIMODAL with vision AND video preprocessors. For a DEVELOPER model the vision tower can likely be SKIPPED entirely on a text-only path, saving both bytes and bring-up work. Confirm the text path runs standalone before porting any vision code.

DECISIVE_REUSE_FINDING.claim: Qwen3.8's linear_attention is the SAME gated-DeltaNet recurrence Hawking already implements for Q80.
DECISIVE_REUSE_FINDING.evidence: Q80 (Qwen3-Coder-Next) source index and Qwen3.8 index share IDENTICAL tensor names for the entire recurrence: linear_attn.A_log, linear_attn.conv1d.weight, linear_attn.dt_bias, linear_attn.norm.weight, linear_attn.out_proj.weight.
DECISIVE_REUSE_FINDING.only_difference: projection FUSION. Q80 fuses in_proj_ba (b,a) and in_proj_qkvz (q,k,v,z). Qwen3.8 SPLITS these into in_proj_a, in_proj_b, in_proj_qkv, in_proj_z. That is an ADAPTER (concat or 4-way bind), not a new implementation.
DECISIVE_REUSE_FINDING.consequence: 48 of 64 layers - the architecturally hardest part - are PARAMETRIC_REUSE with a projection adapter. The remaining 16 full-attention layers are standard GQA with q_norm/k_norm, and all 64 MLPs are plain dense SwiGLU. Bring-up is materially smaller than a new architecture.

DENSITY_VS_TPS_ARITHMETIC.vs_q80: Q80 MoE activates 3.562 G/token. Qwen3.8 dense activates 6.63x MORE despite being a 3x smaller model.
DENSITY_VS_TPS_ARITHMETIC.HARD_CONSEQUENCE_1: 100 TPS is PHYSICALLY IMPOSSIBLE at 3.0 BPW - the ceiling is 92.5 tok/s. It becomes physical at 2.0 BPW (138.8).
DENSITY_VS_TPS_ARITHMETIC.HARD_CONSEQUENCE_2: 50 TPS requires 54% of pure-DRAM-floor efficiency at 3.0 BPW versus 36% at 2.0 BPW. Packed kernels currently run ~0.4% of the measured 560-647 GB/s control, so that difference materially de-risks the floor.
DENSITY_VS_TPS_ARITHMETIC.VERDICT_ON_EASE: The architecture PORT is easy - 48/64 layers are Q80's DeltaNet recurrence with a projection-fusion adapter. The TPS is HARDER than Q80, not easier, because dense activation dominates. Do not carry the 'similar to Q80' intuition across from architecture to velocity.
